name: Queets River
blurb: The Olympic Peninsula's wildest rain-forest river — gravel bars, elk and very few people.

sections.notes: Rough road to the trailhead. Wood everywhere — scout. Olympic National Park requires an entrance pass for all visitors ($30 per private vehicle, valid 7 days; the park is cashless).
Gravel bars and wood. Olympic National Park requires an entrance pass for all visitors ($30 per private vehicle, 7 days); whether Hartzell Creek is inside the park boundary is not confirmed.
